extra_vocab.en: at the place in a store where you pay
extra_vocab.note: 零售與客服情境常見，指在收銀台結帳的當下，常和優惠券、折扣、付款方式一起出現。這是美式說法，英式常用 at the till。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「在收銀台」的介系詞用 at，不用 in 或 on；register 前面要加 the。

examples.en: We cannot accept the expired coupon at the register.
examples.zh: 我們無法在收銀台接受這張過期的優待券。

examples.en: Please show your membership card at the register to get the discount.
examples.zh: 請在收銀台出示會員卡以享有折扣。

examples.en: Customers often ask about delivery options at the register.
examples.zh: 顧客常在收銀台詢問配送方式。

similar.diff: checkout 也指結帳處，英式用法較常見，網購時也可指結帳流程；at the register 專指實體收銀機旁。

example.en: There is a long line at the checkout during lunch hour.
example.zh: 午餐時間結帳處排了很長的隊伍。

similar.diff: counter 是比較泛指的櫃檯，不一定是收銀的地方；at the register 明確指付款處。

example.en: You can pay for your order at the counter.
example.zh: 你可以在櫃檯為你的訂單付款。

confusable.diff: cashier 是「收銀員」這個人；register 是「收銀機、收銀台」這個地方或設備。

example.en: The cashier will scan the coupon at the register before payment.
example.zh: 收銀員會在付款前於收銀台掃描優待券。

extra_vocab.en: will end on a set date or very soon
extra_vocab.note: 用在合約、優惠、會員資格、證件等「快要到期」的提醒，語氣客氣中性，常搭配 on 加日期或 in 加時間。
extra_vocab.pattern: N + is / are due to expire + on / in + 時間
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 這裡的 due to 是 be due to + V 原形，表示「預定要…」；和 due to + 名詞（因為）不同，後面接動詞時前面一定有 be。

examples.en: The maintenance contract is due to expire at the end of this month.
examples.zh: 這份維護合約將在本月底到期。

examples.en: Your membership is due to expire on June 30, so please renew soon.
examples.zh: 你的會員資格將在六月三十日到期，請盡快續約。

examples.en: The supplier's discount offer is due to expire on Friday.
examples.zh: 供應商的折扣優惠將在星期五到期。

similar.diff: set to 強調日期已經排定，語氣和 due to 很接近，在新聞與公告中也常見。

example.en: The special price is set to expire at midnight tonight.
example.zh: 特價將在今晚午夜到期。

similar.diff: about to 表示「就快要」，通常只剩幾天或幾小時，比 due to expire 更緊迫。

example.en: Your passport is about to expire, so renew it soon.
example.zh: 你的護照快到期了，請盡快換發。

confusable.diff: overdue 是已經超過期限（例如付款逾期）；due to expire 是還沒到、但快到期。

example.en: The invoice is overdue, but the contract is only due to expire next month.
example.zh: 這張發票已逾期，但合約要到下個月才到期。

confusable.diff: expired 表示已經過期、失效；due to expire 表示還沒過期，只是快到期。

example.en: The expired coupon was rejected, but the new one is due to expire in June.
example.zh: 過期的優待券被拒絕了，但新的那張要到六月才到期。
